subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below. (Left) 514 414 422 875 167 (Right)

(Example: 467- First digit = 4, second digit = 6 and third digit = 7) (Note: All operations to be done from left to right)

What will be the resultant if the second digit of the highest number is subtracted from the second digit of the lowest number?
solution:
Given: (Left) 514 414 422 875 167 (Right)

According to the question:

 
 

 Given numbers
 514
 414
 422
 875
 167
 
 

 Number are arranged in ascending order
 167
 414
 422
 514
 875
 
 

So,

Second digit of the highest number → 8__**7**__5 → 7

Second digit of the lowest number → 1__**6**__7 → 6

Thus, if the second digit of the highest number is subtracted from the second digit of the lowest number then the resultant will be → 6 - 7 → -1

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
